name: google-review-extension
description: Zoho CRM widget build tooling for the Google Review Link extension. The production-aligned backend lives in backend-python.

scripts.widget:zet: npm run widget:build && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Copy-Item -Force zoho-widget-package/app/index.html zoho-widget-package/app/widget.html; Copy-Item -Force zoho-widget-package/app/index.html zoho-widget-package/app/dashboard.html; Set-Location zoho-widget-package; zet validate; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; zet pack; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Copy-Item -Force dist/zoho-widget-package.zip ../google-review-settings-widget-ZET.zip"
scripts.build: npm run widget:build && npm run widget:zip
